temporal_state_chain.observed: Carolyn notices Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn over the past few days. When Carolyn asks if she is alright, Marilyn says she is overwhelmed with work and some personal stuff and thanks Carolyn for asking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is normally engaging, so her recent quietness and withdrawal are noticeable but unexplained; something may be wrong.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Carolyn learns that Marilyn's quietness is tied to being overwhelmed by work and personal matters, and that Marilyn is not rejecting Carolyn's concern.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is dealing with significant work and personal stress and may need support or someone to talk to.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer support, check in on Marilyn, and be available if Marilyn wants to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After Carolyn's initial approach, Marilyn responds curtly in a later interaction. Carolyn shares her own tough experiences and says talking can help. Marilyn appreciates it, apologizes if she seemed off, and says it has been a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes Marilyn is stressed but appreciated Carolyn's initial concern; Carolyn may feel her support was accepted.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Marilyn's curtness initially makes Carolyn confused and hurt, but Marilyn's apology and explanation reframe the behavior as stress rather than personal rejection.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn's curtness was not personal; she values Carolyn's support and is simply having a very hard week.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Confused and hurt, then relieved and empathetic
temporal_state_chain.intention: Clear any misunderstanding and continue showing support for Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn appeared to respond positively to Carolyn's openness. Carolyn invites Marilyn to a small weekend get-together. Marilyn says it sounds lovely, thanks Carolyn, and says she would love to join.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes the earlier misunderstanding has been resolved and that Marilyn responded well to her openness; she is hopeful about their budding friendship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Marilyn's positive response and acceptance of the invitation confirm that she is interested in social connection beyond work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Their friendship is developing positively, and Marilyn is willing to connect outside of work.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Strengthen the bond by hosting the gathering and building a closer friendship with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Despite friendly interactions outside work, Carolyn perceives that Marilyn still maintains a professional distance at the bank. Carolyn directly asks about their work dynamic. Marilyn says she did not realize this, apologizes if it seemed that way, and agrees to talk and improve collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes their relationship has been warming and that Marilyn is interested in friendship after accepting the social invitation.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Carolyn's perception of continued professional distance at work conflicts with the friendly outside interactions, causing disappointment; Marilyn's willingness to talk suggests the distance may be unintentional or addressable.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn may not have intended to create distance, and they can discuss and improve their work collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Disappointed and confused, then somewhat reassured
temporal_state_chain.intention: Address the work dynamic directly and improve collaboration with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After their private meeting, Carolyn believes they have cleared the air and better understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries. Carolyn proposes teaming up on a new project. Marilyn says it is a great idea, is glad they had the talk, and looks forward to working more closely.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After the previous discussion, Carolyn believes they are addressing the distance and that Marilyn is willing to improve their collaboration, though clearer shared expectations are still needed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Marilyn's positive response to the project proposal confirms that the air has been cleared and that she is enthusiastic about working together more closely.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn and Marilyn understand each other better and have a promising, cooperative working partnership.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Collaborate with Marilyn on the new project proposal and further their partnership.
